question.text: A uniform electric field and uniform magnetic field are acting along the same direction in a certain region. If an electron is projected in the region such that its velocity is pointed along the direction of fields, then the electron

options.text: will turn towards right of direction of motion
will turn towards left direction of motion

solution.text: $\overrightarrow{\mathrm{v}}$ and $\overrightarrow{\mathrm{B}}$ are in same direction so that magnetic force on electron becomes zero, only electric force acts. But force on electron due to electric field is opposite to the direction of velocity.
